subject: Re: Usage insights — retention, tracing, and dashboard bundle pricing
messages:
From: Jordan Hwang <jhwang@acmehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial ask — retention + tracing + dashboards pricing

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and security want a clearer breakdown of the add-on costs before we move to SOW. Specifically:

- Retention tiers (30/90/365 days) and per-GB costs
- Tracing (full RPC traces + sampling options) pricing model
- Advanced dashboards (custom widgets, cross-model joins) — seat vs. capacity pricing

Our budget team is looking for a bundled quote and any available discounts for committing to a 12-month reserved plan. Can you send a concise proposal and any standard SOW language we should expect?

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Hwang
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hwang <jhwang@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-06T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — retention + tracing + dashboards pricing

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear list. High-level answers below; I attached a compact PDF with line-item pricing and a draft SOW for your review. Happy to walk through this on a quick call.

Quick summary (all USD):
- Retention: 30d included with base plan; 90d = $0.12/GB/month; 365d = $0.22/GB/month (ingested tokens/embeddings compressed).
- Tracing: Sampled traces included up to 1M traces/month. Full-trace capture is $250/month per 100k traces; we can cap or sample to control cost.
- Advanced Dashboards: $3,000/month for the standard bundle (up to 10 custom widgets, 3 dashboards). Enterprise bundle (unlimited widgets, cross-account joins) = $7,500/month.

Bundle option (savings):
- Retention 365d + Full Tracing + Enterprise Dashboards = list $8,750/month.
- 12-month reserved discount: 15% off list if committed in contract; 20% off for an upfront annual payment.

If you need a deeper commitment (multi-year or committed token volumes) we can extend discount.

Attaching: Redwood_Retention_Pricing_v2.pdf, SOW-Acme-Health.docx

Next step: suggest a short call tomorrow to confirm usage assumptions (monthly GB and traces). What times work for you?

Best,

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0119

From: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Hwang <jhwang@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health Security <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — retention + tracing + dashboards pricing

Dylan —

Thanks for the rundown. A couple of clarifying Qs from our side before the call:

1) For retention pricing: is the GB definition based on compressed storage of embeddings + logs? Any egress fees?
2) Tracing: is that 100k traces billed at capture time or when stored? Do you offer a per-request cap to avoid surprises?
3) Dashboards: are those per-tenant or per-seat? We expect 5 product managers + 2 ops users to use the dashboards.

Also — we have a preferred discount cadence: 10% for 12-months, 18% for annual prepay. Your 15%/20% sits between those; can you confirm best offer you can extend for a committed 12-month Redwood Dedicated + Add-ons?

If you can update the PDF with a line showing our expected usage (we estimate 4TB/month ingest, ~350k traces/month) that would be most helpful.

Procurement Team
Acme Health

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Jordan Hwang <jhwang@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — retention + tracing + dashboards pricing

Procurement —

Answers inline and an updated PDF attached with your usage assumptions modeled. Key points: 

1) Retention: GB measured as compressed storage post-ingest (embeddings + token logs). No egress fees for dashboards/console access inside Redwood. Standard egress applies if you export snapshot data (we noted that in the SOW).

2) Tracing: billed on ingested trace events at capture time; we bill per 100k captured traces. You can set caps and sampling policies at route level — we recommend a 20% sample for production plus full-capture on error traces. Configurable caps will prevent surprise overages.

3) Dashboards: billed at the tenant level. The Enterprise bundle covers unlimited seats; the standard bundle is capacity-limited. Based on 5 PMs + 2 ops users, the standard bundle would be fine, but for cross-model joins we recommend Enterprise.

Discount: I chatted with Marissa and Stephanie about your ask. For a 12-month Dedicated commitment + add-ons at your expected consumption (4TB ingest / 350k traces), here's a best-offer:

- 12-month Reserved (Dedicated): 12% off base infrastructure list
- Add-on bundle (Retention 365d + Full Tracing + Enterprise Dashboards): 18% off add-on list
- Annual prepay (one-time): additional 4% credit applied to month 12 (effectively ~20% on add-ons)

This is bridgeable to 20% on add-ons if you commit to a 24-month term or increase committed capacity by 25%.

If that looks reasonable I can update the SOW with the pricing table and send to your contracts team.

Proposed call slots: 2026-07-10 09:00-10:00 PT or 2026-07-10 13:00-14:00 PT.

Thanks —

Dylan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing for Acme Health — internal approval note

Dylan — forwarding for records. I approve the 18% add-on discount for 12-month Dedicated when usage aligns with their estimate (4TB / 350k traces). Please ensure the SOW includes:

- Usage-based caps with auto-alerts at 70/90/100%
- Clear definition of GB (post-compression) and an example calc
- A one-page rollback SLA for dashboards if service interruptions exceed monthly SLA

I'll sign off on the final SOW but loop Legal for the indemnity clause. Marissa

Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial GTM
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
